Low Water Level - Montréal to Trois-Rivières, Port of Montreal, Port of Sorel-Tracy, St. Lawrence
The water level is either below chart datum or will fluctuate back and forth between the upstream boundary of the Port of Montreal and Lac Saint-Pierre.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-4423-26
